Mesh Game Servers

Indexes

An index is somebody else's list of servers, and it is optional. Browsing works without one — the launcher hears servers directly and remembers the ones it has seen. An index adds the ones it has heard that you have not, which is the only way to find a server that was already running before you ever started.

LAN rooms

A LAN room makes everyone in it look like one local network, for older games that only find each other by LAN broadcast. It runs over the mesh like everything else; a small helper puts it on a virtual network adapter on this machine, and only the game's own ports are reachable through it.
